title: Build the UV-visible spectrum from owner-produced excited states
summary: Build the UV-visible spectrum from owner-produced excited states. The contract registers the existing owner API and does not certify the accuracy of a particular molecular calculation.
gates: Require positive excitation energies and nonnegative oscillator strengths
Preserve electronic-state matches, declared broadening and wavelength units
Any electronic-structure acquisition remains separately authorized
coordinate_policy: Preserve the ordered molecular identity, isotope masses, coordinate frame and declared owner representation; no geometry remapping or method substitution is implicit.
backend_policy: The scientific owner validates the inputs and numerical controls. Any missing electronic-structure acquisition uses the separately authorized calculation gateway; registration alone launches nothing.
